name: Mountains
descriptions: Jagged grey rock rises steeply around you. Loose scree shifts underfoot, and the wind is sharp and cold.
A narrow ledge winds along the mountainside. Far below, the land spreads out in a patchwork of green and brown.
Boulders the size of houses lie scattered across a high slope, as if tossed there by giants.
Thin, hardy grass clings to cracks in the stone. Snow lingers in the shadowed hollows even now.
The trail climbs between two crags, funnelling a howling wind that tugs at your clothes.
A cold spring trickles from a crack in the rock and freezes into icicles along its edge.
Lichen paints the rocks in orange and green. An eagle circles high overhead, riding the updrafts.

lines: The thin air makes every breath an effort.
